20002.bio: Student of Imam Maalik (Jurisprudence). He was born in 150 H. in Ghaza and was taken to Makkah while a baby. He lived in Egypt where he died in 204 H. He was considered to be one of the most learned persons amongst the Muslim Ummah, unique, learned and the founder of the science of Usul Al-Fiqh (the principles of jurisprudence). His grandfather Shafi'i was a Sahabi who met the Prophet while a growing up boy.
